note: These strengths follow Anne Curry’s reconstruction from English and French financial archives, rather than larger chronicle estimates. The English display value is the midpoint of her 8,500–9,000 range; the French estimate is about 12,000. Other historians disagree on the totals. Named deaths and prisoners in the research are incomplete lists and do not establish a whole-army loss proportion. English longbowmen and French men-at-arms are representative troop types, not the entire composition of either army.
